value.name: Claire silently confirms the man has been missing
value.description: Asha infers from Claire's reaction that the man has not been home since Thursday night and has been absent for several days.
evidence: since the boots came off Thursday night, since the lunch pail was packed for a Friday shift he never walked out the door to take, since the wallet stayed on the shelf through a weekend in which Claire had told the children Daddy was working doubles.
Three nights, then, that Claire had sat at this table with a coat in a closet and two children upstairs and no one to say the words to
value.time_hint: since Thursday night; through a weekend; three nights

value.name: Claire shows relief at being understood
value.description: Claire visibly relaxes when Asha does not react with shock or judgment to the implied truth.
evidence: the relief that broke across her face when Asha did not flinch was harder to look at than the fear had been

value.name: Asha decides to stay overnight
value.description: Asha deliberately places her keys beside the wallet to signal that she will not drive back to the city that night.
evidence: Asha set her keys down on the table next to the wallet, deliberately, so Claire could see her decide not to drive back to the city tonight

value.name: Asha reasons through the man's possible whereabouts
value.description: Asha considers whether the missing man left on foot, left in someone else's car, or has gone nowhere at all, and realizes each possibility implies a different call to make.
evidence: a man who left his license and his cash and his work boots behind had either gone somewhere on foot or gone somewhere in someone else's car or gone nowhere at all, and each of those possibilities pointed to a different number she would have to dial before the children came down for breakfast
value.time_hint: before the children came down for breakfast

value.name: Asha opens her phone to call for help
value.description: Asha picks up her phone and opens the keypad, preparing to make calls based on the man's disappearance.
evidence: Asha picked up her phone from the table and thumbed it open to the keypad

value.name: Rosa texts instructions to start calling
value.description: A text from Rosa instructs Asha to dial the numbers and begin with the detox center without waiting for Claire to speak.
evidence: the screen lit with a text from Rosa: dial the numbers, start with the detox center, don't wait for Claire to speak.

value.name: Asha reads Rosa's message and hides the phone
value.description: After reading Rosa's text, Asha turns the phone face down, signaling she has received instructions and is acting on them.
